title: Code and per-image results for: Skeleton-based losses versus threshold calibration for wheat stem segmentation across ten institutions
description: Training, evaluation and analysis code, data splits, experiment specifications and per-image result tables for a controlled study of two skeleton-based connectivity losses (clDice and Skeleton Recall) for wheat stem segmentation on the GWFSS v1.0 dataset: four architectures, three seeds, random and cross-institution splits, doubled resolution, a leave-one-institution-out experiment, decision-threshold calibration and image-derived stem traits, with a recall-weighted (Tversky) control without a skeleton term, an analysis of the spatial structure (connected components) of the stem prediction and a loss-weight sensitivity analysis. Model weights and the GWFSS images are not included; the dataset is available from the Hugging Face Hub (GlobalWheat/GWFSS_v1.0, CC BY 4.0). Code: MIT licence; result tables and specifications: CC BY 4.0.
